episode_title: What High-Growth Companies Need From Procurement, with Darren Bosman

real_qa.q: What are the key obstacles when setting up a procurement function in high-growth FinTech companies like Tide?
real_qa.r: The main obstacles are decentralized data sitting in different places with inconsistent structures, and overcoming the perception that procurement is a policing function rather than a value-add partner. Darren emphasizes the importance of aligning procurement objectives with business goals and building stakeholder trust to overcome initial resistance.

real_qa.q: What are the key indicators that an organization should transition from decentralized to center-led procurement?
real_qa.r: Duplicated suppliers across different teams is a real indicator, combined with revenue-generating teams wasting time on procurement instead of their core work, and increased risk exposure. When teams are solving the same problems independently without visibility, it signals the need for a center-led approach.
real_qa.requete: decentralized to centralized procurement transition indicators

real_qa.q: How should procurement leaders handle supplier relationships when implementing organizational change and new governance?
real_qa.r: Listen to stakeholders first to identify which suppliers are critical and should not be changed, then explain the business rationale for changes openly. Engage suppliers as partners rather than negotiating adversarially; if a supplier refuses to adapt and is not aligned with your vision, it is better to find a new partner than force a misaligned relationship.

real_qa.q: What is the most important lesson Darren Bosman learned about successful procurement transformation?
real_qa.r: Having stakeholder buy-in and trust is more important than having a perfect procurement process. Getting people to engage and providing a great user experience for stakeholders—whether raising purchase orders or using systems like Omnia—is critical to long-term success.

real_qa.q: How will AI and technology reshape procurement roles over the next few years according to Tide's head of procurement?
real_qa.r: Administrative tasks like purchase orders, invoice processing, and packing lists should be automated by AI. AI-native intake tools can handle risk management and time-consuming tasks effectively. The human role will shift toward strategic oversight, understanding business goals, and designing effective processes rather than tactical execution.

real_qa.q: What soft skills does Darren Bosman prioritize when hiring procurement talent?
real_qa.r: Communication and humility are critical soft skills, more so than hard technical skills which can be taught over time. Understanding what the team actually needs is challenging since every business is different; procurement leaders must tailor hiring to specific departmental needs rather than following generic job descriptions.

guest.bio_context: Darren Bosman is a procurement leader who has built and scaled functions across industries and regions from South Africa and the Seychelles to the UK. He is currently head of procurement at the FinTech Unicorn Tide, where he helps the business scale through robust systems, enhanced commercial excellence and a partnership-led approach to procurement.
